gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-ibm-plex-sans-: Marker-bold and sunlit, Red Hat Display draws every letter with one constant line. IBM Plex Sans Thai Looped follows with curves that refuse to close, so give that body text a size comfortably larger than you'd first guess.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-imprima: Imprima reads smooth and tube-like, its terminals flaring gently outward. Red Hat Display earns its keep up top, where big, short lines show off its marker-like stroke and bright curves.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-inclusive-sans: Red Hat Display leads with a bold, marker-like line and daylight in every curve. Inclusive Sans follows with round letters whose rims match their stems, so nudge its size up a touch and let those open ends breathe.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-inria-sans: Contemporary through and through, Red Hat Display draws each letter with a marker's constant line and light inside every curve. And Inria Sans brings tubular strokes like bent copper pipe, which is where this pairing is strongest.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-istok-web: Modern in feel, Red Hat Display holds the fixed-width line of a stencil brush, while Istok Web leans on rounded letters with one clearly open side. Its strongest quality is that friendly, approachable body.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-jost: Clean and professional, Jost sits quietly under a heading with real swagger. Red Hat Display brings its marker-bold line and open curves, while Jost's broad terminal gaps and uniform stroke keep a long stretch of text smooth going.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-jura: Neutral and tidy, Jura works beneath a loud, contemporary heading. Jura keeps its strokes as constant as bent wire, with s curves opening wide at both ends, so a long passage glides along under Red Hat Display.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-k2d: Marker-bold up top, tube-smooth below: Red Hat Display draws one constant line with daylight in each curve. But K2D is the one for steady reading, holding its thickness through every bend while its c terminals hang far from the bowl.
gen-fs-red-hat-display-gf-kanchenjunga: Bold, marker-drawn letters with light inside each curve lead the way in Red Hat Display. Kanchenjunga holds the steady line of a technical drafting pen, so shrink the heading and it loses its swagger, while a larger body stays crisp.
